title: Excellent tour
text: We really enjoyed our experience on the Segways. Our group was small, which allowed us more interaction with our guide. We spent several days in Barcelona, and this tour showed us many places and perspectives of Montjuic and the surrounding area that we didn’t see via any other way during our stay.

title: Would do it in a heartbeat!

title: Great walk for the discovery of Montjuic
text:
We made the tour of Montjuic in private which is great.
Our guide Elisa was great, she knows Barcelona very well and gave us anecdotes about the city.
I recommend this tour and visit with Elisa.
author: Franck1172

title: Excellent family experience!!!
text: Excellent tour of the city and Montjuïc with Max, our guide. The latter was able to share his knowledge and his good humor. We highly recommend this experience both fun and cultural. A big thank you to Max for his professionalism!!!

title: Monjuic in Segway
text:

author: cambierfrancis

title: We Loved the Tour
text: We loved this tour. Oscar was a wonderful guide and was very responsive to all of our questions. We especially were thankful that he strayed from the preset route at my request and took us into the Montjuic cemetery. I have wanted to see that for years.  Thanks for a great tour, Oscar!
author: Marty61701
